en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large, rectangular, three‑storey villa with simple neoclassical lines, a glazed veranda, and several tall chimneys. The house stands above a stone wall and dense trees, next to a broad paved terrace bordered by a metal railing. To the right, along the wall, is a small round watchtower with a conical roof, resembling part of a fortification or castle enceinte. Hills or mountains are faintly visible in the distant background. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.
